control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console D-1: read-only queue dashboard (what is waiting for the team today). Emits navigation actions only.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: maxShiftHours (12), missingReportDays (2), tolerancePct (5), confidenceThreshold (0.85).

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] for this week (Mon-Sun) plus the last missingReportDays+30 days.

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report - PBS Hub]: waiting ones plus those linked to the schedules above.

property.name: EvidenceJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report Automation - PBS Hub] for the waiting reports and today.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for the current month (no GPS or selfie columns needed).

property.name: HostsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaHost, Status, HasRekening. Never send KTP or NoRekening.

property.name: StudiosJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Studio - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaStudio, KapasitasHost, Status.

property.name: BrandsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Brand - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaBrand.

property.name: PayrollJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Payroll - PBS Hub]: Title, Periode, Status, Created (latest few).

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is still loading the lists: renders skeletons.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing). Blank = the device clock.

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message}. Unused by navigation, reserved.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload} emitted on click. Handle it in OnChange.
